displayName: 团结乡样本 01 GLB 双档质量合同

sharedGeometry.statement: 高精度主档和网页标准档共用完整 High 扫描几何；网页标准档没有删减网格或三角面。

high.role: high-fidelity editable master and manual desktop viewing
high.loadingPolicy: explicit user action only; use on a device whose MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE is at least 7000

standard.loadingPolicy: explicit user action; fallback for lower-memory and lower-texture-limit devices

viewerQuality.unsupportedHighTextureFallback: show an explicit error and direct the user to the standard profile

knownSourceLimits: The high profile improves texture fidelity but does not add geometry beyond the source High scan.
Holes, fragmented boundaries, vegetation artifacts and occlusion gaps already present in the scan remain unresolved evidence, not reconstructed surfaces.
Physical dimensions and orientation remain unverified until survey controls are supplied.
